typography.usage: Instrument labels, counts and technical fields.

recognitionRules: Use a dark ink framework with pale blue reading areas and warm exception fields.
Pair Menlo instrument labels with Helvetica Neue explanations.
Give key counts and decision fields enough space to read at a glance.
Keep evidence, interpretation and next action distinct within the review.
Do not merge with Issue Desk solely because both use dark instrument styling.
Preserve the source conditional state colors and accompanying labels only when their recorded condition applies; do not turn exception, venue or validation colors into universal logo accents.
Use pink/red validation cells for missing, invalid or over-planned actuals; retain the dark header and pale-blue summary field.

principles: Name the choice, its owner and the condition that makes it complete.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Read the signal. Check the record. Choose the next intervention.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid certainty about forecasts, capacity or commitments that are still provisional.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: This is the assumption; this is the decision it affects.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

profile.logoDirection: Use PROJECT INSTRUMENT DESK in Menlo with a small pair of calibration ticks. No speedometer or heartbeat icon.
invariants: Use a dark ink framework with pale blue reading areas and warm exception fields.
Pair Menlo instrument labels with Helvetica Neue explanations.
Give key counts and decision fields enough space to read at a glance.
adaptations: A compact review retains the decision and evidence fields.
Monochrome editions use labels and border weight to retain status meaning.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

logoProduction.productionMethod: Brand-specific outlined typography with calibration-ticks source mechanism. Precise native geometry; no raster masquerading as SVG.
logoProduction.productionNotes: Self-contained SVG masters contain real paths. PNG exports are rendered at 2x with MuPDF. No raster is described as editable vector. Source family substitutions are explicit in fontsUsed and brand-font-plan.
